releases.title: Watch list, live suggestions, personal ranking
items: New Watch List tab — the titles you flagged had been saving all along with nowhere to show them.
"Not interested" button on suggestions, with undo and a reset.
My ranking sort on the Ledger — drag your own entries into the order you actually liked them.
Five more palettes: Noir, Drive-In, Technicolor, Nitrate, Terminal. Palette and density now stick between visits.
This panel: what's been added to the archive, and what's changed on the site.

releases.title: Suggestions rebuilt from scratch
items: What's Next now rebuilds from your ledger every time you log something, instead of serving a list frozen back in August.

Match scoring rebalanced three ways: a five-star favourite outweighs a three-star shrug by roughly 17x instead of 2x, genre affinity is back, and dense clusters of cross-referencing documentaries no longer bury titles only a couple of favourites point at.
Your personal ranking feeds the scoring too.
Fixed: candidates were excluding anything anyone in the house had watched, which made "New to me" impossible to satisfy.
Service filter dropdown now fills in — it only ever offered "Any service".

releases.title: Logging fixes
items: Log a Film clears itself after saving. It used to keep the last rating, date, note and liked flag.
Watch date defaults to today, read from the local clock — anything logged after 7pm was being stamped with tomorrow's date.
Logging something clears it off the Watch List automatically.
Match badges are visible again; the trailer button had been painting over them since it went in.
